processes.name: dispatch API
processes.description: The API receiving dispatch requests, live job status interactions, and work orders.

data_flows.name: open console
data_flows.description: The duty engineer opens the dispatch console.

data_flows.name: dispatch requests
data_flows.description: The dispatch console sends dispatch requests to the dispatch API.

data_flows.name: live job status
data_flows.description: The dispatch console exchanges live job status with the dispatch API.

data_flows.name: pull schedule feed
data_flows.description: The schedule importer pulls a schedule feed from the scheduling partner.

data_flows.description: The schedule importer stores schedule documents in the schedule archive.

data_flows.description: The schedule importer posts work orders to the dispatch API.

data_flows.name: read write job orders
data_flows.description: The dispatch API reads and writes job orders in the dispatch database.

data_flows.name: load console
data_flows.description: The duty engineer loads the console from the corporate web host.

assumptions.assumption: The scheduling partner platform is controlled by a different party from the corporate and production zones.
assumptions.basis: The zone is named "scheduling partner platform", indicating a partner-controlled platform.

assumptions.assumption: The production control plane holds greater authority than the corporate network.
assumptions.basis: The zone is named "production control plane", indicating a privileged control-plane zone.

assumptions.assumption: The corporate network is a network-location boundary under the same organisational control.
assumptions.basis: The zone is named "corporate network" and no separate party or authority distinction is stated.

assumptions.assumption: The schedule archive holds operating schedule records.
assumptions.basis: The diagram states that the schedule importer stores schedule documents in the schedule archive.

assumptions.assumption: The dispatch database holds operating job-order records.
assumptions.basis: The diagram states that the dispatch API reads and writes job orders in the dispatch database.

assumptions.assumption: The schedule importer handles operating schedule and work-order records.
assumptions.basis: The diagram shows it pulling schedule feeds, storing schedule documents, and posting work orders.

assumptions.assumption: The dispatch API handles operating dispatch, status, and job-order records.
assumptions.basis: The diagram shows dispatch requests, live job status, work orders, and job orders associated with the dispatch API.

assumptions.assumption: The dispatch console handles operating dispatch and job-status records.
assumptions.basis: The diagram shows dispatch requests and live job status associated with the dispatch console.

assumptions.assumption: The scheduling partner presents operating schedule records.
assumptions.basis: The diagram shows the scheduling importer pulling a schedule feed from the scheduling partner.

assumptions.basis: The flow opens the dispatch console, which is used for dispatch operations.

assumptions.assumption: The live-job-status flow carries operating job-status records.
assumptions.basis: The flow is explicitly labelled "live job status".

assumptions.assumption: The pull-schedule-feed flow carries operating schedule records.
assumptions.basis: The flow is explicitly labelled "pull schedule feed".

assumptions.assumption: The store-schedule-documents flow carries operating schedule records.
assumptions.basis: The flow is explicitly labelled "store schedule documents".

assumptions.assumption: The post-work-orders flow carries operating work-order records.
assumptions.basis: The flow is explicitly labelled "post work orders".

assumptions.basis: The flow is explicitly labelled "read write job orders".
